members.name: open
members.doc: Open or create database at path given by *file*. Optional argument *flag* can be 'r' (default) for read-only access, 'w' for read-write access of an existing da

members.name: whichdb
members.doc: Guess which db package to use to open a db file. Return values: - None if the database file can't be read; - empty string if the file can be read but can't be r
